To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
PGL3, a plastidic isoform of 6P GL, is essential for plant growth and defense, and that the oxidative section the plastidic PPP is essential for the growth of Arabidopsis thaliana.
6PGL is required for plant growth and defense, and is essential for normal plastidic PPP activity, but is dispensable for peroxisomal PPP activity.

the oxidative section (6PGL and G6PDH) of the plastid PPP are essential for plant growth and that the pgl1, pgl2 and pgl5 mutants provide useful genetic tools for defining the roles of the cytosolic PPP and the oxidative section of plastidic PPP.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of the oxidative section of plastidic PPP in plant growth and defense.
the role of the oxidative section of plastidic PPP and its impact on the regulation of the SA/NPR signaling pathway in Arabidopsis.
the characterization of Arabidopsis P6GL T DNA insertion mutants, and the role of PGL3 and the oxidative section of PPP in plant growth and defense responses.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
PGL1,2,4,5 are dispensable for plant life, whereas PGL3 plays an essential role for normal growth and development of Arabidopsis.

the oxidative section (i.e. glucose 6 phosphate (G6P) dehydrogenase (G6PDH) and 6P GL) of the PPP is essential for normal plant growth and development and is required for the SA/NPR 1 mediated defense responses.
PGL3 plays a key role in plant growth and defense by maintaining the balance between oxidative and reductive PPP in plastids, and that the oxidative PPP is required for plant growth and defense.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
PGL3 functions in the oxidative section of PPP and is essential for plant growth and defense.

the oxidative PPP is required for plant growth and that the PPP in plastids is required for normal plant growth and development, and that the PPP plays an essential role in the SA/NPR3-mediated signaling pathway.
6PGL is required for plant development, and its activity is required for the normal growth and development of plants.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the oxidative section (but not reductive section) of the plastid PPP plays a critical role in plant growth and defense.
6PGL plays a critical role in maintaining the redox homeostasis in the oxidative section of plastidic PPP.
the oxidative section in plastids of the PPP is required for plant growth and normal development and that the oxidative PPP in plastids is required for SA/NPR1-mediated signaling.
